rules.title: Tournament Rules & Regulations
rules.subtitle: Official guide to the prediction league

items.text: The competition is based on virtual predictions. No real money is involved.
For each round, the organizers pick a list of the week's most interesting, top-tier matches. All participants must pick their predictions strictly from this list.
The platform automatically aggregates odds from 82 leading bookmakers and calculates their average.
Only selections with odds strictly greater than 1.40 are accepted.
Each round, the 10 participants are split into 5 pairs (Player 1 vs Player 2, Player 3 vs Player 4, etc.). Over a season, everyone plays everyone else 5 times (9 opponents × 5 cycles = 45 rounds).
In each championship round, a player picks exactly 3 matches from the shared weekly list.
The winner is whoever correctly predicted more of their 3 picks (e.g. 3:2, 2:1, 1:0).

rows: More correct picks than the opponent
Fewer correct picks than the opponent

callout.title: "Goals scored" tiebreaker (odds)
callout.text: As a secondary metric (similar to goal difference), the total accumulated odds is used. Each round, the odds of correct picks are multiplied together like an accumulator/parlay. If two players are tied on points in the Championship table, the one with the higher total accumulated odds across the tournament ranks higher.

section3.title: 3. Cup (5 rounds)
section3.intro: The Cup tournament consists of two consecutive stages:

stage1.title: Stage 1: Qualifying (2 rounds)
items: All 10 players submit predictions into a shared table (no direct opponents).
Format: 2 rounds of 5 matches from the weekly list each (10 matches total).
Ranking criteria: 1) Number of correct picks; 2) Total accumulated odds.
Advancing to the playoffs: Players ranked 1st through 8th advance to the Cup bracket. Players ranked 9th and 10th are eliminated from the Cup.

stage2.title: Stage 2: Playoffs (3 rounds)
items: Final (1 round) — the deciding duel for the Cup
stage2.note: The 8 qualified players are placed into the bracket by random draw. Playoff matches follow the H2H duel format (3 matches from the weekly list).

items.text: Pick your predictions strictly from the published weekly list.
Odds for each selected outcome must be > 1.40.
3 matches per round, played as a 1-on-1 duel against an opponent.
5 matches per round, played for points on a shared table.
Pick your odds wisely — if points are tied, whoever's winning odds are higher comes out on top!

rules.footer: Football Prediction League • Fair Odds • High Excitement
